BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.

2. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.

3. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.

4. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.

5. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

6. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

9. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

10. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.

11. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project Phase 11 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Building Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
